notes: This version-controlled file is the proposed build-time compatibility policy for the first API-enabled Studio release.
Release builds validate and bundle this declaration as an immutable application resource; production does not load a user-editable replacement.
At runtime Studio compares this bundled policy with jl-mixing system-info --json to derive the current compatibility state.
system.info is required to enter Automation API mode; missing workflow capabilities disable only their corresponding Studio features.
Studio reports compatible full-functionality, compatible limited-functionality, incompatible, and Automation-unavailable states.
Compatibility policy changes require a reviewed source change, compatibility tests, and a new Studio release.
Studio 1.0 remains tied to the released JL Mixing Automation 1.3.0 command contract until Automation API 1.0 is implemented and adopted.
